acceptance_signals: The audit separately covers Codex, Claude Code, and identifiable DeepSeek coding-host surfaces using official primary documentation where available.

The capability matrix records each transition, timing, mechanism, trusted decision path, evidence, bypass or failure behavior, confidence, and an honest OBSERVE, ADVISE, MEDIATE, BLOCK, or UNKNOWN ceiling.
Post-action observation is not described as blocking an already completed side effect, while any block claim names the exact future transition it can prevent.
The report proposes minimum Harness Contract v1 fields without introducing or changing Kernel semantics.
Unknown or undocumented host behavior is marked UNKNOWN rather than inferred.
The report recommends Codex only as the first conformance implementation and does not implement or configure a host adapter.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-a14b1a49355b47e2b493b033682fada1 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Create a repository-native Host Enforcement Capability Audit v1 for Codex, Claude Code, and DeepSeek using current official documentation and bounded local evidence. Record transition-level capabilities, honest enforcement ceilings, unknowns, and the minimum fields required by a future vendor-neutral Harness Contract v1.

items: Vendor documentation may have changed and must be cited with access context.
A hook that returns a decision may still be bypassable or limited to selected tools, so enforcement must not be overstated.
General model APIs must not be conflated with an execution harness.
Reviewed assumption: This is a documentation-only technical audit and does not change product behavior or release identity.
Reviewed assumption: Official vendor documentation is primary evidence; repository contracts and tests are supporting evidence for current AgentGov behavior.
Reviewed assumption: DeepSeek may refer to more than one product or host surface, so conclusions are scoped to specifically documented surfaces.
Reviewed unknown: Whether DeepSeek publishes a canonical coding-agent host with lifecycle hooks comparable to Codex or Claude Code.
Reviewed unknown: Whether every documented pre-action hook is synchronous and authoritative enough to support a truthful BLOCK claim for an exact transition.
Reviewed unknown: Whether host capabilities differ between CLI, IDE, desktop, and API surfaces.

title: Audit host enforcement capabilities for Harness Contract v1
